baseline.note: Snapshot from current main at audit start; metadata is an audit baseline, not a live counter. The standalone register does not add research facts or change the existing census.

decision: Gate A inspection partial; Gate B subsystem inventory incomplete; Gate C OEM interchange unverified.
scope: Candidate comparison around original 9-5 MY2004-09 B235 and NG9-3 MY2005-06 B207 FWD, with explicit unassessed alternatives; not a fleet-wide Saab reliability ranking.
method: Read repository Phase 0 coverage audit, gap closure plan and priority source-backed datasets.
Cross-link priority acceptance needs to exact existing gap IDs; never close a gap by rewording it.
Mark additional neglected subsystem questions as new_coverage_question instead of pretending original source searches were completed.
Keep paper/source gap versus real vehicle/VIN/measurement gap distinct.
No part recommendation, failure probability, official supersession or engineering simulation generated from this register.
